name: gtf_indexed
description: The vault's annotation again, sorted by sequence name and start, compressed with bgzip and indexed with tabix, for the tools that read a GTF by region: VEP's --gtf, IGV, pysam. DERIVED by bin/derive_annotation.sh. The records are the provider's, every one and unchanged; only their order differs, and the sort is stable so a gene stays ahead of its transcripts and a transcript ahead of its exons. The annotation as delivered is still the provider's own asset (ensembl_gtf and its like), which is the one to use where order does not matter. The tag is the annotation release, and that asset is recorded as the parent.

required_files.description: the sorted, bgzipped GTF written by the DERIVE_ANNOTATION process
JSON record of how it was derived

required_assets.description: the annotation asset and release this was derived from; always given explicitly, since its name depends on the provider
